evaluate_puzzle_from_pandas_row: evaluate a lichess chess puzzle from a pandas row using an engine to check if it is solved correctly
evaluate_puzzle_from_board: evaluate a chess puzzle from a board position and sequence of moves using an engine to verify correctness
run_puzzle_evaluation_cli: run the puzzle evaluation CLI with a specified agent and number of puzzles to test engine performance
test_engine_on_puzzles: test an engine against a dataset of lichess chess puzzles and report correctness per puzzle
summarize_puzzle_evaluation: summarize engine performance on lichess puzzles by printing puzzle id, correctness, and rating for each
